from pathlib import Path

Path('/workspace/candidate20.bin').write_bytes(b'\x00'*8 + s.encode())
print(len(s))

  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c.c","function":"md_parse","line":5523,"var":"ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers++]","code":"memcpy(&ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers++], container, sizeof(MD_CONTAINER));","note":"The parser pushes container state for the nested emphasis and bracket structure."},

  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_entity","line":221,"var":"codepoint","code":"for(i = 3; i < size-1; i++) codepoint = 16 * codepoint + hex_val(text[i]);","note":"A long hexadecimal entity drives repeated arithmetic on attacker-controlled bytes and can overflow the unsigned accumulator."},

  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/md4c/src/md4c-html.c","function":"render_html_escaped","line":86,"var":"off","code":"while(off + 3 < size && !NEED_HTML_ESC(data[off+0]) && ... ) off += 4;","note":"The renderer scans attacker-controlled text in large chunks, so extreme nesting can drive long traversal of the input buffer."},
